[SWS_CM_00087] Precondition for Proxy destruction
⌈
To avoid dangling refer-
ences to
Event
sample data (referred to by a
ara::com::SamplePtr
) which has not
yet been handed back to communication management by the application, it is required
that all
ara::com::SamplePtr
s provided by
GetNewSamples()
are released (by
calling any of the APIs defined in [SWS_CM_11547], [SWS_CM_11539], [SWS_CM_
11540], or [SWS_CM_11545]) before destroying the
Proxy
(e.g., by letting it go out of
scope). If this precondition is not met, a violation shall be raised as per [SWS_CORE_
00090].
⌋
7.5.13 Service event subscription
For the service event subscription C++ API reference, see chapter 8.3.2.2.4.4,
8.3.2.2.4.6, 8.3.2.2.4.1, 8.3.2.2.4.3, 8.3.2.2.4.2 and 8.3.2.2.4.5.
